components.name: Availability Status
components.description: Communicates current availability as a compact mail link.
components.css: .ds-availability { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #4ade80; border-radius: 9999px; background: #dcfce7; color: #16a34a; font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-availability:hover { background: #86efac; } .ds-availability:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f2937; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-availability-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #22c55e; }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: A quiet structural label that moves into the left margin at large widths.
components.css: .ds-section-label { color: #9ca3af; font: 600 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: normal; }

components.name: Project Placeholder
components.description: A temporary bounded panel for unfinished portfolio sections.
components.html: Under Construction
components.css: .ds-placeholder { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #4b5563; font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-placeholder-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #facc15; color: #111827; } .ds-placeholder-mark svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Timeline Entry
components.description: Pairs a quiet date with a strong education or work title on one structural rule.
components.html: October 2023 - PresentMaster in Software Engineering & Internet Computing
components.css: .ds-timeline { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 0 0 40px 16px; border-left: 1px solid #e5e7eb; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-timeline-dot { position: absolute; top: 6px; left: -6px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 1px solid #ffffff; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e5e7eb; } .ds-timeline time { color: #9ca3af; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; } .ds-timeline strong { color: #111827; font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; }

components.name: Inline Reference
components.description: Links supporting copy to source material without competing with primary content.
components.css: .ds-reference { color: #2563eb; font: 400 16px/24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-reference:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-reference:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Footer Navigation
components.description: A plain, low-friction pair of supporting navigation links.
components.css: .ds-footer-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; font: 400 16px/24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-footer-nav a { color: #1f2937; text-decoration: none; } .ds-footer-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-footer-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f2937; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio should feel like a well-prepared work surface: quiet enough to focus, exact enough to trust, and tactile enough to reveal a person behind the evidence. The narrow reading column, native typography, flat surfaces, and direct language keep attention on finished work rather than presentation tricks. Every visual decision should help a recruiter move from first impression to proof. Engineering credibility leads; design judgment appears in the quality of hierarchy, interaction, imagery, and finish. The system explicitly rejects generic SaaS styling, flashy agency effects, dense resume-like walls of text, and excessive animation.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet, exact, and assured visual voice.
Native typography with a deliberately small scale.
Flat structure defined by spacing, hairlines, and alignment.
Tactile feedback reserved for real interactive states.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Every prominent visual element must either establish identity, expose proof, or help the visitor act.

rules.name: The Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Saturated color must name a state, a reference, or an exception. If color has no job, remove it.

rules.name: The Native Clarity Rule
rules.body: Typography must load instantly and read like interface copy, not a styled editorial artifact.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Never add a drop shadow to make a component feel finished. Use spacing, border contrast, or an intentional state change.

rules.name: The Tactile Restraint Rule
rules.body: Interaction feedback must be obvious at the pointer or keyboard focus, then disappear without leaving decorative residue.

dos: Do place selected work and its evidence before biography detail.
Do use real product imagery, GitHub activity, client or employer marks, and measurable outcomes as proof.
Do preserve the narrow reading measure and the established spacing rhythm.
Do use Available Green, Reference Blue, Selection Red, and Construction Yellow only for their named jobs.
Do provide visible focus states, semantic markup, strong contrast, keyboard access, and reduced-motion alternatives for WCAG 2.2 AA.
donts: Don't turn pages into dense resume-like walls of text.
Don't use excessive animation; entrance motion must support an already-visible default and respect reduced motion.
Don't add gradient text, decorative glass surfaces, wide soft shadows, or oversized card radii.
Don't repeat tiny tracked eyebrow copy above every section heading.
